title: Harden observability and audit baseline

context.summary: Add the MVP observability helpers needed for structured logs, model operation audit queries, job/stage metrics, health snapshots and rate-limit documentation.
context.background: Mindory already has Fastify JSON logs, request ids, rate-limit headers and @mindory/llm audit hooks. TASK-84 turns the empty observability package into the shared baseline used by docs and runtime health surfaces.

in: Implement @mindory/observability helpers for structured log events, model audit querying, job stage metrics and health snapshots.
Expose API health/readiness payloads with uptime, timestamp, logging and rate-limit observability metadata.
Add validation coverage for the observability package and API health payload tokens.
Document model operation audit fields, job/stage metrics, health endpoints and the MVP rate-limit strategy.
Update repository status, support matrix and changelog.
out: External log aggregation or alerting integrations.
Distributed rate limiting across API replicas.

acceptance_criteria: @mindory/observability exports structured log, model audit query, job stage metric and health snapshot helpers.
Model operation audit records can be filtered by role, provider, status and project/document/job/session refs.
Job stage metrics can report counts and duration summaries by job type, stage and status.
API /health and /ready include request id, timestamp, uptime and baseline observability metadata.
Docs describe structured logs, model operation audit fields, job/stage metrics, health endpoints and the rate-limit strategy.

manual_checks: Confirm metrics/tracing/exporters remain documented as future hardening.
Confirm observability helpers do not store secrets or raw bearer tokens.

risks: Audit helpers must not imply durable enterprise audit persistence.
Health endpoints must remain lightweight and not require database/Redis probes in bare app tests.
Rate-limit docs must clearly state the in-process limitation.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to done.
Branch is committed and merged back into master.
